title: Handwriting beside its transcription
description: Checking a doubtful word opens the matching line on the image.

blocks.text: After a letter has been recognized, a person spends time hunting for the place of the error in another window.

quote.text: I had 2 letters that our mother's hand wrote. We needed them turned into typed letters. Scanned both letter just fine. But the transfer to text were complete fails!! 1-3 words per line (when shared to computer), words were jumbled together and also parsed into fractions of the word.

blocks.text: Link the text to the lines of the original, let a word be corrected quickly and keep both versions. Export the chosen text after a look through it.
A place that couldn’t be read is better left marked than quietly filled with a plausible phrase.
